For p*>2 the l_p norm is C2 even at vectors with zero individual coordinates; pair sums 2e_i have vanishing Hessian. Rebuilt exact rational projection-block matrix M with blocks P_u+delta_ij P_vi, and independently computed characteristic polynomial z(z-1)^4(3z²-12z+4)^2/9, kernel exactly span X*. Multiplying eigenvalues by (p*-1)/2 yields stated spectrum, hence Taylor expansion off scaling ray yields sharp transverse ratio (p*-1)(1-sqrt6/3)/2. Uniform C2 Taylor estimates ensure local positivity for all perturbation directions, not just sampled ones. Positive-definite restricted Hessian on H={X·X*=9} gives IFT unique nearby normalized minimizer and derivative -6 log(3)/p*²; positive one-sided p<p* cone follows from homogeneity. No global Hornich-Hlawka endpoint theorem is asserted.
